blurb: Guests take a 2-hour guided tour through Hollywood, Beverly Hills, and Los Angeles in open-air sprinter vans with shade. The tour includes sightseeing of major locations, celebrity homes, the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Rodeo Drive, movie studios, filming locations, and celebrity hangouts. The tour is fully narrated with live guides and departs hourly.
